overview_description.description: Ascend.io, named a 2021 Gartner Cool Vendor, provides the most advanced automation for data and analytics engineering workloads. Ascend unifies the core capabilities of data engineering—data ingestion, transformation, delivery, orchestration, and observability—into a single platform so that data teams deliver 10x faster. Ascend is backed by the world’s leading venture capital firms, including Accel, Sequoia Capital, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and 8VC; and supported by notable advisors, such as Kevin Scott, CTO of Microsoft; Maynard Webb, Board Member Salesforce, Visa; Scott McNealy, former Sun Microsystems CEO; Luanne Dauber, former CMO at Confluent and VP Marketing at Pure Storage; and Deep Nishar, Senior Managing Partner of Softbank Vision Fund. For more information about Ascend, visit www.ascend.io.

product.name: Ascend AI Data Engineering Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for building, deploying, operating, and optimizing end-to-end data pipelines across ingestion, transformation, orchestration, observability, and DataOps.

product.name: Agentic Data Engineering
product.description: AI-assisted data engineering capabilities that help teams create, document, troubleshoot, maintain, and optimize data pipelines using context from their data stack.

product.name: Data Pipeline Automation
product.description: Automation for scheduling and operating data pipelines through metadata-driven dependencies, event triggers, validation, recovery, and workload optimization.

product.name: Data Operations and Observability
product.description: Integrated DataOps and observability functions for version control, CI/CD, access management, lineage, pipeline monitoring, troubleshooting, and data quality management.

identifier.value: Data Engineering Migration and Professional Services

product.name: Data Engineering Migration and Professional Services
product.description: Onboarding, architecture, implementation, and migration assistance for teams modernizing pipelines from Airflow, dbt, AWS Glue, and other legacy ETL platforms.
